test_message: This is a test message, to check both the translation and the text display.
name: Name
no_lists_yet: You haven't created any shopping lists yet. Start now by clicking the "New List" button!
no_items_yet: You haven't added any items to this shopping list yet. Add some now! :)
dashboard_information: This is where all the shopping lists you create will appear. Start creating new ones in the Shopping List section!
empty_list: Empty Shopping List. Add new items by entering the list.
confirm_add_cart: Are you sure you want to add the items to the cart?
confirm_remove_cart: Are you sure you want to remove the items from the cart?
confirm_purchase: Are you sure you want to mark the items as purchased?
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete these items?
confirm_delete_single: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
item_in_cart_cannot_delete: An item in the cart cannot be deleted. Take it out of the cart first.
login_help: Accounts are created by your family administrator.
login_failed: These credentials do not match our records.
login_throttled: Too many login attempts. Try again in :seconds seconds.
password_must_differ: The new password must be different from the temporary one.
password_rules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
must_change_password: You are using a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
new_member_help: A temporary password is generated for the new member. They must change it on first login.
cannot_delete_yourself: You cannot remove your own account.
last_admin_error: A family must keep at least one admin.
admin_role_help: Admins can manage the family and do everything with every list.
confirm_reset_password: Generate a new temporary password for this member?
temporary_password_notice: Temporary password (the family name, to be replaced at first sign-in):
permissions_help: What this member may do with each type of list. Any permission includes viewing.
list_type_in_use: This list type still has lists. Move or delete them first.
hidden_from_help: Selected members will not see this list at all (e.g. for surprise preparations).
bo_first_admin_help: Every family starts with one admin, who then adds the rest of the family from the web app. A temporary password is shown once after saving.
bo_delete_family_warning: This permanently deletes the family with all its members, list types, lists and items. This cannot be undone.
bo_sign_out_everywhere_confirm: Ends every session and signs out every phone of this member.
bo_password_keep_help: Leave blank to keep the current password.
bo_reset_two_factor_confirm: Removes the authenticator app from this account. They will set it up again at next sign-in.
bo_last_admin_error: You cannot delete the only super administrator.
bo_code_help: Short code such as pt, en, es or pt-BR. It cannot be changed later.
bo_flag_help: Shown next to the language. Search by name, e.g. language-es or country-br.
bo_default_help: Used for anyone who has not picked a language. Only one language can be the default.
bo_delete_language_warning: This also deletes every text typed for this language.
bo_placeholder_error: Keep these placeholders in the text: :placeholders
bo_slug_help: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. The page is shown at /p/address.
bo_temp_password_hint: This is the family name. They must replace it the first time they sign in.
bo_role_key_help: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. content-editor. Built-in roles keep theirs.
bo_permission_key_help: area.action, e.g. pages.update. Built-in permissions cannot be renamed: the code looks them up by this key.
bo_admin_roles_help: What this person may do in the backoffice. Combine roles to combine their permissions.
bo_super_admin_note: This role can do everything, including anything added in the future. It cannot be changed or deleted.
bo_delete_role_warning: Administrators with this role lose its permissions.
bo_delete_permission_warning: Roles that include this permission lose it.
bo_last_super_admin_error: There must always be at least one super administrator.
bo_role_support_desc: Helps families: sees them and their members, adds members, resets passwords.
bo_role_content_editor_desc: Writes the pages and edits the texts.
bo_role_translator_desc: Edits the texts of each language.
bo_role_viewer_desc: Can look at everything and change nothing.
bo_menu_parent_help: Put it under another link to make a dropdown (navbar) or a column (footer). Leave empty for a top-level link.
bo_menu_location_help: Navbar: the top bar. Account menu: under the person's name. Footer: the bottom of every page.
bo_menu_screen_help: One of the app's own screens. Pick who sees the link: the screen itself stays protected either way.
bo_menu_audience_help: Hiding a link does not protect a page: it only decides who is offered it.
bo_menu_url_help: A full address (https://...) or a path of this site (/p/about). Leave empty, with no page, for a heading that only holds other links.
bo_menu_url_invalid: Use an address starting with http:// or https://, or a path starting with /.
bo_menu_label_help: What people read. Optional for a page or a screen: it uses their own name. Languages left empty use the default language.
bo_menu_delete_warning: Links under this one are deleted with it.
app_server_help: The address of the Cestou server, such as https://lists.example.com
app_cannot_reach: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
app_sync_error: Could not sync. Tap to try again
app_unsynced_warning: :count change(s) have not been synced yet. If you log out now they will be lost.
app_family_offline: Managing the family needs a connection.
app_notifications_help: A notification when someone else in your family adds items, puts them in the cart or buys them, even with the app closed. The phone looks about every 15 minutes.
app_notifications_denied: Android is blocking notifications for this app. Allow them in the phone settings.
app_nearby_help: When this phone cannot reach the server, it looks for other phones of your family nearby that run exactly the same version of the app, and swaps the changes not sent yet. As soon as any of them reaches the server, everything is sent and brought up to date. Keep the app open, with Bluetooth on.
app_nearby_connected: connected to :name · last sync: :sent sent, :received received
app_nearby_other_version: a phone nearby has version :version: install the same one on both to sync
app_nearby_expired: a phone nearby must reach the server once to be trusted
app_nearby_permission: Allow Bluetooth and nearby devices for this app, so it can find your family phones.
app_nearby_radio_failed: Could not start. Turn on Bluetooth (and location, on older phones).
app_delete_member_confirm: Remove :name from the family? Their phones are signed out.
app_devices_help: The phones signed in with your account. Sign out one you lost.
app_rejected_forbidden: :name: you are not allowed to do that, so the change was undone.
app_rejected_not_found: :name: it no longer exists or is not available to you.
app_rejected_in_cart: :name: it is in the cart, so it was not deleted.
app_rejected_invalid: :name: the server could not accept this change.
app_offline_intro: No account and no server: your family's lists live on your phones and are kept in step between them, over Bluetooth. Nothing is ever sent to the web app.
app_offline_code_help: Ask someone in the family for it: it is in Settings on their phone.
app_offline_code_invalid: That is not a family code: it has 12 letters and digits.
app_offline_code_text: Give this code to the others in the family. On their phones: Use the app offline, then I have a code. Keep it private: anyone who has it can join.
app_offline_mode_note: This phone works without the web app. It only syncs with the family's phones nearby, with Bluetooth on and the app open.
app_offline_family_unknown: (learned from the first phone you meet)
app_offline_leave_confirm: Leave the family? Its lists are removed from this phone. The other phones keep them.
app_local_starting: Starting to look for family phones…
app_local_off: Not looking for family phones: switched off in Settings
app_offline_scan_wrong: That QR code is not a family code.
app_offline_scan_denied: The camera is not available. Allow it in the phone's settings, or type the code.
app_family_remove_confirm: Take :name off the list? Their phone keeps working, but they will not show here.
app_family_qr_help: To bring another phone in: Use the app offline, I have a code, Scan a QR code. Keep it private.
app_family_type_in_use: Cannot be deleted: it is the first one, or has lists
app_family_members_help: Tap a person to see what they may do.
app_family_members_admin_help: You started the family, so you are its admin: tap a person to set what they may do and which lists are hidden from them.
app_member_saved: Saved. It reaches their phone the next time it meets one that has it.
app_member_only_admin: Only the family's admin can change what people may do.
dashboard_cart_empty: Nothing in the cart right now.
app_offline_searching: Looking for a phone of this family nearby…
app_offline_not_found: No phone of the family has been found yet. Keep both phones close, with the app open and Bluetooth on.
app_offline_leave_alone_confirm: Leave the family? No phone of the family is nearby to be told, so until it is they will still list you. Its lists are removed from this phone.
app_offline_leave_admin_confirm: Leave the family? You are its admin, so it passes to :name, who has been in it the longest. Its lists are removed from this phone.
app_offline_leave_admin_needs_phone: You are the family's admin: another phone of the family must be connected to take the family over before you leave. Connect to one (the strip at the top says when it is connected) and try again.
app_offline_leave_not_said: The hand-over did not reach the other phone. Try again.
app_family_background_help: To stay connected to the family with the screen off, Android must let this app run in the background. Without it, the phone may stop the app to save battery.
app_member_founder: Started the family: always an admin, and nobody can change that.
